About
Rabeeh Abbasi is working as a tenured professor at the
Department of Computer Science
, Quaid-i-Azam University, Islamabad, Pakistan. He completed his PhD from the
Institute of Web Science and Technologies (WeST)
University of Koblenz-Landau, Germany. He has a vast research experience in the fields of social media analytics, network science, and data science. His research focuses on leveraging positive aspects of social media including social mediaâ€™s use in

a number of BS, MS, and PhD theses. He has also supervised a number of BS, MS, and PhD theses. As a supervisor, his main goal is establishing a research culture, where researchers are motivated to address research problems associated with real-life. As a teacher, his focus is on developing the interest of students in the courses they study, equipping them with the latest tools, technologies, and concepts, and helping them in becoming a progressive part of the community.
